scripts.test:fixtures:up: docker-compose -f infra/docker-compose.test.yml up -d postgres synapse model github inngest && timeout 120 sh -c 'until docker-compose -f infra/docker-compose.test.yml exec -T postgres pg_isready -U matrix -d matrix_test >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8008/_matrix/client/versions >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4010/health >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4020/health >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8288/dev >/dev/null; do sleep 2; done' && docker-compose -f infra/docker-compose.test.yml exec -T synapse /tests/fixtures/synapse/seed.sh
